Lemma
[Equivalent Null-Cover Formulations]

1. ch6:6.1The definition of measure zero is unchanged if open rectangles are replaced by open balls or by open cubes. Every open rectangle $R\subseteq \mathbb R^n$ has a finite open-cube cover of total volume at most $2^n$ times the volume of $R$.
